addressed_findings.title: Validly signed malformed external session publish spent Vault TON without charging Message Budget
addressed_findings.resolution: Post-accept invalid signed requests consume nonce and debit the bounded invalid-request Message Budget charge before returning without publish.

addressed_findings.title: WithdrawTon to Vault self-recipient could turn user ledger TON into uncredited reserve
addressed_findings.resolution: WithdrawTon rejects recipient == myAddress() before debiting the user ledger.

addressed_findings.title: WithdrawAth to Vault self-recipient could destroy the user's internal ATH claim
addressed_findings.resolution: WithdrawAth rejects recipient == myAddress() before debiting the user ledger or creating a pending withdrawal.
